title: Get verified and set up payouts
summary: Add your documents and payout account.

steps.headline: Get verified
steps.body: From Home or Profile, tap Get verified.
steps.narration: You need to get verified before you can send proposals. Tap Get verified on Home or in Profile.

steps.headline: Choose your ID
steps.body: Pick the kind of ID you will use, like PhilSys or a driver's licence.
steps.narration: First, choose your ID, like PhilSys, a driver's licence or a passport.

steps.headline: Photo of your ID
steps.body: Take a clear, full photo of your ID.
steps.narration: Take a clear, full photo of your ID. Then tap Use this photo.

steps.headline: Selfie
steps.body: Take a selfie so we can match you with your ID.
steps.narration: Next, take a selfie so we can match you with your ID.

steps.headline: Certificate
steps.body: Upload a certificate for each service you offer, like TESDA or PRC.
steps.narration: Then upload a certificate for each service you offer, like a TESDA or PRC certificate.

steps.headline: Review and send
steps.body: Check your documents, then send them for review.
steps.narration: Check your documents, then send them. We review them automatically, and an admin makes the final check.

steps.headline: Payout account
steps.body: Open Profile, then Payout account. Choose GCash, Maya or Bank.
steps.narration: Last, open Profile, then Payout account. Choose GCash, Maya or Bank, then tap Save account.

steps.headline: Check your status
steps.body: Tap Check again to see the result, then See jobs near you.
steps.narration: Then wait while we check your documents. Tap Check again to see the result, then tap See jobs near you.
